class.name: HTMLLayout
class.brief_description: Parses and lays out a static HTML document for drawing on a [CanvasItem].
class.description: Use [method parse] to load an HTML document or fragment and [method layout] to set its viewport size. Call [method draw] from the target [CanvasItem]'s [method CanvasItem._draw] callback. Call [method CanvasItem.queue_redraw] after changing the document, viewport size, or drawing position. Supports block and inline layout, lists, tables, text, solid backgrounds and borders, local images, and rectangular overflow clipping. Text uses the project theme's default font or Godot's fallback font. Run the renderer on the main thread.

method.name: clear
method.description: Releases the document, layout, and drawing resources, and clears the last error.

method.name: draw
method.description: Draws the current layout during [method CanvasItem._draw]. Both the top-left drawing position and the optional axis-aligned clip rectangle are in the canvas item's local coordinates. The default clip applies only the document's clipping rules. Before a successful layout, this method draws nothing.

method.name: get_anchor_rect
method.description: Returns the bounds of the first laid-out element with the given case-sensitive HTML [code]id[/code], in document coordinates. Pass the ID without [code]#[/code]. Returns an empty rectangle if the element has no layout or the ID is absent.

method.name: get_content_size
method.description: Returns the content size in pixels from the most recent successful layout of the current document. Returns [constant Vector2i.ZERO] before layout and for an empty document.

method.name: get_link_at
method.description: Returns the original [code]href[/code] of the link at a point in document coordinates, or an empty string. Subtract the drawing position from the canvas-local point and apply any caller-supplied clip before querying. The caller handles navigation.

method.name: get_render_error
method.description: Returns the diagnostic message from the last failed parse or layout. A successful parse or layout clears the message.

method.name: get_plain_text
method.description: Returns the laid-out text in document order. Block boundaries and explicit line breaks are represented by newlines, and table cells are separated by tabs. Soft wrapping does not add newlines. Returns an empty string before layout.

method.name: get_selection_rects
method.description: Returns highlight rectangles in document coordinates for the character range from [param from] up to [param to]. Offsets refer to [method get_plain_text] and are clamped to its length. Rectangles are clipped to the HTML layout's visible regions.

method.name: hit_test_text
method.description: Returns the nearest caret offset in [method get_plain_text] for a point in document coordinates. Returns [code]0[/code] when there is no text.

method.name: layout
method.description: Updates media queries and lays out the current document using the viewport width and height in pixels. Returns [constant OK] on success, [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for nonpositive dimensions, [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] before a successful parse, or [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA] if the layout cannot be represented.

method.name: parse
method.description: Replaces the document and resets its layout. An empty string creates an empty document. Styles come from inline attributes, [code]<style>[/code] elements, and the optional stylesheet text. Images can be imported PNG, JPEG, WebP, or SVG textures. Relative paths are resolved from [param base_dir] and may use [code]../[/code] within the project. Absolute [code]res://[/code] paths are also supported. A missing or unsupported image is skipped. Returns [constant OK] on success, [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for a base directory outside [code]res://[/code], or [constant ERR_PARSE_ERROR] if the document cannot be parsed.
